en.headline: Two own commits plus 15 automated commits; two new discussions opened
en.summary: On 2026-10-13, the user made **2 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, alongside 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The two own commits both touched the daily-report pipeline: one removed a duplicated empty-gate in the AI layer and added regression cases, and the other fixed a bug where an empty day was swallowing the discussion and other appended sections. No pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases were recorded for the day. The user also opened two new discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: `#4821` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" and `#4823` titled "[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK", both filed under the Ideas category with no comments yet.
